tv_wonder_roll_next_slot_from_priority_deck_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_unique_has_any_feasible_proposal_trigger = yes }
		tv_wonder_unique_roll_random_feasible_proposal_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_generic_has_any_feasible_proposal_trigger = yes }
		tv_wonder_generic_roll_random_feasible_proposal_effect = yes
	}
}

tv_wonder_copy_sacred_mountain_survey_from_location_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:tv_wonder_selected_survey_site }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_scale_competence value = scope:tv_wonder_selected_survey_site.var:tv_wonder_sacred_mountain_scale_competence }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_logistics_competence value = scope:tv_wonder_selected_survey_site.var:tv_wonder_sacred_mountain_logistics_competence }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_organization_competence value = scope:tv_wonder_selected_survey_site.var:tv_wonder_sacred_mountain_organization_competence }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_complete value = 1 }
		remove_variable = tv_wonder_survey_active
		tv_wonder_set_io_survey_progress_effect = { value = 100 }
		tv_wonder_update_construction_tiers_from_competence_effect = yes
	}
}

tv_wonder_mechanics_copy_completed_survey_from_location_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_selected_survey_site
			var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 1
			scope:tv_wonder_selected_survey_site = { has_variable = tv_wonder_surveyed_sacred_mountain }
		}
		tv_wonder_copy_sacred_mountain_survey_from_location_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_selected_survey_site
			var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 2
			scope:tv_wonder_selected_survey_site = { has_variable = tv_wonder_surveyed_triumphal_axis }
		}
		tv_wonder_copy_triumphal_axis_survey_from_location_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_selected_survey_site
			var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 3
			scope:tv_wonder_selected_survey_site = { has_variable = tv_wonder_surveyed_great_port }
		}
		tv_wonder_copy_great_port_survey_from_location_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {

tv_wonder_mechanics_start_survey_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:target
		}
		tv_wonder_clear_current_survey_effect = yes
		scope:target = { save_scope_as = tv_wonder_selected_survey_site }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_site value = scope:target }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_stage value = 2 }
		if = {
			limit = { tv_wonder_selected_survey_already_cached_trigger = yes }
			tv_wonder_copy_completed_survey_from_location_effect = yes
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_active value = 1 }
			tv_wonder_prepare_survey_competence_targets_effect = yes
			tv_wonder_set_io_survey_progress_effect = { value = 0 }
		}
	}
}

tv_wonder_mechanics_complete_survey_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_survey_active_trigger = yes }
		clamp_variable = { name = tv_wonder_scale_competence min = 0 max = 100 }
		clamp_variable = { name = tv_wonder_logistics_competence min = 0 max = 100 }
		clamp_variable = { name = tv_wonder_organization_competence min = 0 max = 100 }
		tv_wonder_update_construction_tiers_from_competence_effect = yes
		tv_wonder_store_survey_on_location_effect = yes
		tv_wonder_mechanics_reveal_suitability_knowledge_effect = yes
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_complete value = 1 }
		remove_variable = tv_wonder_survey_active
		remove_variable = tv_wonder_survey_speed
		remove_variable = tv_wonder_scale_competence_target
		remove_variable = tv_wonder_logistics_competence_target
		remove_variable = tv_wonder_organization_competence_target
		remove_variable = tv_wonder_scale_competence_monthly_gain
		remove_variable = tv_wonder_logistics_competence_monthly_gain
		remove_variable = tv_wonder_organization_competence_monthly_gain
		tv_wonder_set_io_survey_progress_effect = { value = 100 }
		if = {
			limit = { tv_wonder_survey_site_selected_trigger = yes }
			var:tv_wonder_survey_site ?= { save_scope_as = tv_wonder_event_location }
		}
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_competence_average value = var:tv_wonder_scale_competence }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_competence_average add = var:tv_wonder_logistics_competence }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_competence_average add = var:tv_wonder_organization_competence }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_competence_average divide = 3 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.300 }
	}
}

tv_wonder_mechanics_push_location_display_slot_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_wonder_display_count } }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_display_count value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_wonder_display_count < 1 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_display_slot_1_id value = $wonder_id$ }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_display_slot_1_level value = $wonder_level$ }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_display_count add = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_wonder_display_count < 2 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_display_slot_2_id value = $wonder_id$ }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_display_slot_2_level value = $wonder_level$ }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_display_count add = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_wonder_display_count < 3 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_display_slot_3_id value = $wonder_id$ }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_display_slot_3_level value = $wonder_level$ }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_display_count add = 1 }
	}
}

tv_wonder_mechanics_refresh_location_display_state_effect = {
	tv_wonder_mechanics_clear_location_display_state_effect = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				this = location:alexandria
				has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_pharos_lighthouse_inaugurated
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_display_unique_pharos_lighthouse_level value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_display_any_wonder value = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_pharos_lighthouse_inaugurated value >= 6 }
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_display_unique_pharos_lighthouse_level value = 6 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_pharos_lighthouse_inaugurated value >= 5 }
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_display_unique_pharos_lighthouse_level value = 5 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_pharos_lighthouse_inaugurated value >= 4 }
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_display_unique_pharos_lighthouse_level value = 4 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_pharos_lighthouse_inaugurated value >= 3 }
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_display_unique_pharos_lighthouse_level value = 3 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_pharos_lighthouse_inaugurated value >= 2 }
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_display_unique_pharos_lighthouse_level value = 2 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_pharos_lighthouse_inaugurated value >= 1 }
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_display_unique_pharos_lighthouse_level value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_pharos_lighthouse_inaugurated }
			set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_display_unique_pharos_lighthouse_ritual_style value = 1 }
		}
		tv_wonder_mechanics_push_location_display_slot_effect = { wonder_id = 101 wonder_level = var:tv_wonder_display_unique_pharos_lighthouse_level }

			}
			set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_display_city_expansion_project_level value = 4 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_city_charter value >= 3 }
					location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_civic_grid value >= 3 }
					location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_urban_renewal value >= 3 }
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_display_city_expansion_project_level value = 3 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_city_charter value >= 2 }
					location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_civic_grid value >= 2 }
					location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_urban_renewal value >= 2 }
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_display_city_expansion_project_level value = 2 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_city_charter value >= 1 }
					location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_civic_grid value >= 1 }
					location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_urban_renewal value >= 1 }
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_display_city_expansion_project_level value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_city_charter }
			set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_display_city_expansion_project_ritual_style value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_civic_grid }
			set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_display_city_expansion_project_ritual_style value = 2 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_urban_renewal }
			set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_display_city_expansion_project_ritual_style value = 3 }
		}
	}
}

tv_wonder_mechanics_recalculate_total_owned_buildings_effect = {
	set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_ritual_current_total_buildings value = 0 }
	every_owned_location = {
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_ritual_current_total_buildings add = this.num_buildings }
	}
}

tv_wonder_mechanics_snapshot_total_owned_buildings_effect = {
	tv_wonder_mechanics_recalculate_total_owned_buildings_effect = yes
	set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_ritual_total_buildings_baseline value = var:tv_wonder_ritual_current_total_buildings }
}

tv_wonder_mechanics_clear_selected_ritual_runtime_effect = {
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_ritual_auxiliary_building_finished
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_ritual_total_buildings_baseline
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_ritual_current_total_buildings
}

		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_ritual_in_progress value = 1 }

		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_ritual_timer value = 1 years = 1 }

tv_wonder_mechanics_start_auxiliary_building_ritual_effect = {
	tv_wonder_mechanics_clear_selected_ritual_runtime_effect = yes
	set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_ritual_in_progress value = 1 }
	set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_ceremony_locked value = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_construction_site_selected_trigger = yes }
		var:tv_wonder_site ?= {
			if = {
				limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 1 var:tv_wonder_ceremony_style ?= 2 } }
				construct_building = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_sacred_mountain_ritual_annex }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 2 var:tv_wonder_ceremony_style ?= 2 } }
				construct_building = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_triumphal_axis_ritual_annex }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 3 var:tv_wonder_ceremony_style ?= 2 } }
				construct_building = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_great_port_ritual_annex }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 4 var:tv_wonder_ceremony_style ?= 2 } }
				construct_building = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_giant_necropolis_ritual_annex }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 5 var:tv_wonder_ceremony_style ?= 2 } }
				construct_building = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_great_lighthouse_ritual_annex }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 6 var:tv_wonder_ceremony_style ?= 2 } }
				construct_building = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_hydraulic_workshop_ritual_annex }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 7 var:tv_wonder_ceremony_style ?= 2 } }
				construct_building = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_mining_city_ritual_annex }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 8 var:tv_wonder_ceremony_style ?= 2 } }
				construct_building = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_giant_observatory_ritual_annex }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 9 var:tv_wonder_ceremony_style ?= 2 } }
				construct_building = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_palace_of_nations_ritual_annex }
			}

tv_wonder_mechanics_maybe_complete_active_ritual_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = tv_wonder_ritual_in_progress
			tv_wonder_selected_ritual_completion_requirements_met_trigger = yes
		}
		tv_wonder_mechanics_apply_selected_ritual_completion_effect = yes
		remove_variable = tv_wonder_ritual_in_progress
		remove_variable = tv_wonder_ritual_timer
		tv_wonder_mechanics_clear_selected_ritual_runtime_effect = yes
		tv_wonder_finalize_effect = yes
	}
}

tv_wonder_complete_active_ritual_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tv_wonder_ritual_in_progress }
		tv_wonder_mechanics_apply_selected_ritual_progress_effect = yes
		tv_wonder_mechanics_maybe_complete_active_ritual_effect = yes
	}
}

tv_wonder_confirm_ceremony_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_ceremony_ready_for_confirmation_trigger = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { tv_wonder_selected_generic_timed_ritual_trigger = yes }
			tv_wonder_mechanics_start_timed_ritual_effect = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { tv_wonder_selected_generic_auxiliary_building_ritual_trigger = yes }
			tv_wonder_mechanics_start_auxiliary_building_ritual_effect = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { tv_wonder_selected_generic_artwork_decoration_ritual_trigger = yes }
			random_work_of_art_in_country = { save_scope_as = tv_wonder_sacrificed_artwork }
			destroy_art = scope:tv_wonder_sacrificed_artwork
			if = {
				limit = { tv_wonder_selected_deferred_immediate_ritual_trigger = yes }
				tv_wonder_mechanics_start_deferred_immediate_ritual_effect = yes
			}
			else = {
				tv_wonder_mechanics_apply_immediate_ritual_effect = yes
				tv_wonder_finalize_effect = yes
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { tv_wonder_selected_deferred_immediate_ritual_trigger = yes }
			tv_wonder_mechanics_start_deferred_immediate_ritual_effect = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					tv_wonder_selected_generic_immediate_ritual_trigger = yes
					tv_wonder_selected_generic_scaled_gold_decoration_ritual_trigger = yes
					tv_wonder_selected_generic_prestige_decoration_ritual_trigger = yes
				}
			}
			tv_wonder_mechanics_apply_immediate_ritual_effect = yes
			tv_wonder_finalize_effect = yes
		}
	}
}
